summary: TXNM Energy filed a preliminary prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for a $400 million common stock offering, with Wells Fargo Securities as underwriter. Shares trade on NYSE under TXNM; last sale price was $57.64 on August 28, 2026. This is a routine capital raise via an at-the-market or underwritten offering under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. No deal terms, strategic event, or unusual corporate action is indicated. The filing is a standard equity issuance for general corporate purposes, so it falls outside special-situations categories.
